description.value: At 13th level, the black mage attains flexibility in metamagic knowledge. Once per day, as part of his meditation to regain lost MP, the black mage may gain the benefit of one metamagic feat that he doesn't possess. The black mage must meet the prerequisites of the metamagic feat. At 16th, once per day, the black mage is able to spend a full-round action to change the metamagic feat he selected at the beginning of the day for a different one. At 19th, he may exchange the metamagic feat twice per day.
